description.value:
Requirements You're in Bladework Stance and your Favored Blade is a melee weapon.

With a quick movement, your blades spin around you, tearing your enemies away. All creatures within your Favored Blade's reach take damage equal to your Favored Blade's damage dice with a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|basic] save against your soaring blade DC. The damage type is the same as your Favored Blade. The DC of this action is affected by your multiple attack penalty.
